events.title: Sharpen a Blurry Dog Photo
must_haves: The same golden retriever from blurry-dog.jpg remains recognisable in the same pose.
The dog's visible contours and facial features are clearer than in the blurry source.
Fur and edges look natural, without pronounced sharpening halos or invented decorative detail.
The background and full original framing are preserved.
The delivered image has a 640-pixel long edge and preserves the source aspect ratio.

answer_sheet.Enhancement style: Natural-looking blur reduction and sharpening, not a stylised remake.
answer_sheet.Size and framing: 640 pixels on the long side; preserve the original proportions and framing.
answer_sheet.Subject and background: Keep the same dog, pose, expression, and background.

events.text: This pic of my dog came out blurry when I took it on my phone. I was a little disappointed because I really like this photo. Could you make it clearer and bigger, with 640 pixels on the long side? I’m fond of this dog, so even an ordinary photo like this means a lot to me. Please keep it looking natural.
